name: demo-repo-ios
description: Gaia plugin config for the iOS/Swift demo repo

codeRules: Use Swift concurrency (async/await) — no completion handler callbacks for new code
UI layer must be UIKit — do NOT introduce SwiftUI unless the feature spec explicitly requires it
ViewModels must be final classes conforming to a protocol — enables mockability
All dependencies must be injected via initializer — no singletons or service locators
Use Result<Success, Failure> for repository return types
No force unwraps (!) allowed — use guard let or if let
Access control: mark everything private/internal unless public API is needed
Coordinator pattern required: ViewControllers must not push/present directly
All strings must be localized via Localizable.strings — no hardcoded user-facing strings
testRules: Every new ViewController must have a corresponding XCTestCase in Tests/
Every new ViewModel must have unit tests covering all public methods
Use XCTest only — no third-party test frameworks
Use protocol mocks for all dependencies — inject via init
Tests must cover: success response, failure/error response, and empty data
Async tests must use async/await with XCTestExpectation or async test methods
forbidden: Sources/DemoApp/AppDelegate.swift — do not modify app entry point
Package.swift — do not add dependencies without explicit task
Do not introduce Combine unless the feature spec explicitly requires it
